name: @mplot/viewer
description: Dependency-light interactive browser viewer for MPlot artifacts

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp src/style.css app/index.html dist/ && mkdir -p dist/fonts && cp node_modules/computer-modern/fonts/cmu-serif-{500-roman,500-italic,700-roman}.woff2 dist/fonts/ && cp node_modules/computer-modern/OFL.txt dist/fonts/ && sed -i.bak 's/[[:space:]]*$//' dist/fonts/OFL.txt && rm -f dist/fonts/OFL.txt.bak && cp node_modules/fzstd/esm/index.mjs dist/fzstd.js && sed -i.bak 's/from "fzstd"/from ".\/fzstd.js"/' dist/loader.js && rm -f dist/loader.js.bak
